The equatorial block `TRAJ_EQ_REF` is generated by
`capture/regenerate_equatorial.jl` from `../../equatorial_quadrature_oracle.jl`.
Run from the repository root:

```
julia --project=capabilities/Spacetime capabilities/Spacetime/test/fixtures/capture/regenerate_equatorial.jl --write
```

The oracle integrates the separated Kerr first integrals in the Darwin angle
χ, with r=p/(1+e cosχ), Q=0 and M=1. It uses the package constants E,L, with
(a,L) → (−a,−L) symmetry for negative spin. It does not call a trajectory,
frequency, elliptic-integral or harmonic implementation. Factoring the radial
potential cancels the turning-point zeros analytically:

```
r3 = 2/(1-E²) − p/(1-e) − p/(1+e), r4 = 0
 dλ/dχ = √(1-e²) / [(1+e cosχ)√((1-E²)(r-r3)r)]
 P = E(r²+a²) − aL, Δ = r²−2r+a²
 dt/dλ = (r²+a²)P/Δ + a(L−aE)
 dφ/dλ = aP/Δ + L−aE, dτ/dλ = r²
```

Gauss–Legendre integration gives Λr and the secular averages. A safeguarded
Newton inversion of λ(χ)=q/Υr determines each phase. Integrating the rates
minus their averages gives Δt, Δφ and Δτ with zero pericentre offsets.
The sign of dr/dλ follows sinχ on the full period. The 256-bit, 128-node
calculation must agree with 384-bit, 160-node integration to scaled error
below 1e-65 before Float64 rounding. Running the generator without `--write`
checks exact regeneration. The cases and phases remain those in
`test_trajectory.jl`, including q=4.5 and 6.0. The original equatorial fixture
inherited the legacy asin(sn) branch defect and was superseded. Its negative
spin case also lacked the reflection used by the frequency routine.

The radial, polar, full and proper-time blocks retain their original
KerrGeodesics provenance and bytes; they are not rebaked by this generator.

One original radial fixture has Ur=1.066240299940009e-6 at q=0 because
subtracting terms in R(r) left a rounding residual before the square root.
The radial test uses the exact Ur(0)=0 condition at pericentre; all nonzero
phase samples retain their original comparison tolerances.

The negative-spin `spin_orbit` fixture also embedded the old geodesic chart.
Its stored negative-spin scalar/shifted-element values are superseded by
`test_spinning_secondary.jl`'s radial-root displacement calculation and
quadrature at the resulting pTilde,eTilde. Both K and the trajectory use the
corrected constants. The assembly formula is
Δt_spin = Δt_geo − 3s/(2√K̃) Δτ_geo. The fixture's other cases remain unchanged.
This checks consistency of the existing linear-spin assembly; it does not
constitute an independent certification of the underlying spin dynamics.
